title: PFA debt event (v2) — append-only ledger entry, mirrored from a PFOS transaction/debt record
description: v2 (2026-10-02): *_egp float fields migrated to *_milliunits integers per money-rules.md. The confidence enum (CONFIRMED/ESTIMATED/ASSUMPTION/STALE) is retired — every event here is mirrored from PFOS's deterministic engine, which does not estimate. See ADR-ZAYD-001.

amount_milliunits.description: Amount of the event (payment amount, new limit, etc.)

source.description: v1 allowed a free-text source string; v2 pins it to PFOS_engine because this ledger is a mirror, not an independently maintained record.

idempotency_key.description: SHA256 of ts+debt_id+event_type to prevent duplicate appends
